summary: Aether MVP iteration 1 — comprehensive backend + frontend testing. Found and fixed 1 critical backend bug (str.format KeyError in DEBATE/INTERVIEW system templates due to unescaped JSON braces) that was blocking /api/debate/start and /api/interview/start (500 errors). After fix, 15/15 backend tests pass and all key frontend flows verified on mobile viewport (375x667 equivalent).

minor.issue: Server relies entirely on the LLM returning finished=true on the 5th user answer. The LLM does not always honor the end_hint, making the 'finishes after 5 answers' contract non-deterministic. Recommend force-setting finished=True server-side when turn_count >= 5, regardless of LLM response. Also force data.get('question','') to '' in that case.
Uses Pydantic v1-style `.dict()` (user_to_out(user).dict()). With Pydantic v2 this still works but is deprecated; prefer .model_dump().
Streak is set to 1 at signup but _touch_streak is not called on signup; only login triggers it. Minor — first signup login next day will still bump correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Bottom tab buttons have no testID — testing must rely on visible text. Suggest adding tabBarTestID per Tabs.Screen (testID='tab-home', 'tab-train', 'tab-debate', 'tab-analyze', 'tab-mentor').

issues: React Native Web warnings: "shadow*" style props deprecated, use boxShadow. Multiple components emit this warning. Non-blocking but should be migrated.
props.pointerEvents deprecated warning on at least one component.

action_items: Make interview finish deterministic: in /api/interview/answer, set finished=True server-side when sum(user turns) >= 5 (and override data['finished']=True, data['question']='').
Add testID props to bottom Tabs.Screen entries (tabBarTestID) so UI tests don't depend on visible label text.
Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow across components to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: DEBATE_SYSTEM_TEMPLATE and INTERVIEW_SYSTEM_TEMPLATE used .format() with literal JSON braces, causing KeyError: '"opponent_reply"' / '"question"'. Braces must be escaped as {{ }}. Fixed in /app/backend/server.py.
server.py is ~780 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, mentor.py, speech.py, debate.py, interview.py, missions.py, dashboard.py).

LLM JSON parsing in llm_json() is defensive (falls back to {_raw: text}) — good. But several endpoints return {_raw: ...} silently with 200, which would surface as broken UI. Consider logging a warning when fallback fires.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] is fine for MVP but should be tightened for production.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (escaped JSON braces in DEBATE_SYSTEM_TEMPLATE and INTERVIEW_SYSTEM_TEMPLATE)

success_rate.frontend: 100% on flows tested (login, home, mentor chat with AI reply, debate tab + suggested topic → session screen → turn → finish breakdown, analyze tab → navigate to feedback with scorecard, train tab, quick-interview tile → mock interview screen)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used demo@aether.app / demo1234 (already exists). Mission completion + speech analyze created records under demo user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend file split + interview deterministic finish are the remaining fixes. Frontend flows are all functional end-to-end with real Claude Sonnet 4.5 responses. AI endpoints take ~5-12s; use ≥60s timeouts. Tab navigation in playwright currently uses page.get_by_text('Home'|'Train'|'Debate'|'Analyze'|'Mentor', exact=True).last because tabs lack testIDs.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE — /api/debate/start and /api/interview/start returned 500. Backend traceback: KeyError: '"opponent_reply"' (and '"question"' for interview). The system-message template strings embed a JSON schema example like {"opponent_reply": str, ...} and then call .format(stance=..., topic=..., level=...). Python's str.format treats every { ... } as a placeholder, so it tried to look up a parameter named "opponent_reply" and crashed. FIX — escape every literal brace in the JSON example as {{ and }}. After fix: debate/start, debate/turn, debate/{id}/finish, interview/start, interview/answer all return 200 with valid LLM-parsed JSON. Verified via 15/15 pytest run and end-to-end UI walkthrough.
